name: qoodle-suite
description: Monorepo: SDK, servidor MCP y API REST para loguearse por SAML y leer contenido de Qoodle (Moodle UVQ).

scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter qoodle-sdk run build && pnpm --filter qoodle-rest-api run dev
scripts.start:api: pnpm --filter qoodle-sdk run build && pnpm --filter qoodle-rest-api run start
scripts.dev:mcp: pnpm --filter qoodle-sdk run build && pnpm --filter qoodle-mcp-server run dev
